scope: Independent small tooling smoke of the current shared CollectAxioms traversal and both production allowlist guards. This is not a paper-proof audit or a release-wide certification.

reviewed_sources.lines_read: entire file; shared collection expression and per-axiom guard cloned into smoke
entire file; shared collection expression and filtered allowlist guard cloned into smoke

collector_semantic_read: A single ReaderT Environment / StateM CollectAxioms.State is run over targets.forM collect; visited and axioms are shared across all targets.

collect inserts a declaration in visited before recursion, reads the kernel-checked environment, and records each reached axiom constant. Shared dependencies are therefore traversed once without clearing their previously collected axioms.
The implementation traverses both declared type and value for definitions, theorems, and opaque constants. Private theorem names are ordinary referenced constants and are traversed in the same way.

Constructors and recursors have their types traversed; inductive constants traverse their type and constructors. Quotient primitive handling and allowlisted standard axioms follow the installed Lean implementation.

The production Audit guard loops over the resulting union; Dependencies filters that same union against the identical three names. Neither guard limits the check to direct dependencies or public project names.

fixture_design.clean: Two theorem targets share a private theorem behind an opaque constant. That private proof deliberately exercises all three allowed axioms. Both deliberately introduced unrelated test axioms remain in the same environment but are outside this target closure; the collected array is exactly the standard three.
fixture_design.hidden: Two targets share an opaque constant whose private proof combines the clean shared proof with forbiddenProof : True. The fixture asserts that both private and opaque nodes were visited and that the collected array contains exactly the standard three plus forbiddenProof.
fixture_design.type_only: Two targets have declared type (fun _ : Prop => CleanStatement) forbiddenType, while each proof body is cleanOpaque. The fixture explicitly asserts that forbiddenType occurs in each actual declared type and does not occur directly in its stored proof body; the collected union must nevertheless contain it plus the standard three.
fixture_design.guards: All three fixtures are run once with Audit.lean's per-axiom guard and once with Dependencies.lean's filtered guard. Expected negative tests deliberately finish with Lean exit1 from the production-style rejection; their preceding fixture assertions must all succeed.

reproducible_fixture_sources.common_declarations_prefix:
import Lean.Util.CollectAxioms
import Lean.Elab.Command

namespace SharedUnionAuditSmoke

def CleanStatement : Prop :=
  (True = True) ∧ (∃ _ : Unit, True) ∧
    (Quot.mk (fun _ _ : Unit => True) () = Quot.mk (fun _ _ : Unit => True) ())

private theorem cleanShared : CleanStatement :=
  ⟨propext Iff.rfl,
    ⟨Classical.choice (show Nonempty Unit from ⟨()⟩), True.intro⟩,
    @Quot.sound Unit (fun _ _ => True) () () True.intro⟩

opaque cleanOpaque : CleanStatement := cleanShared

theorem cleanA : CleanStatement := cleanOpaque
theorem cleanB : CleanStatement := cleanOpaque

axiom forbiddenProof : True
private theorem hiddenShared : CleanStatement ∧ True := ⟨cleanOpaque, forbiddenProof⟩
opaque hiddenOpaque : CleanStatement ∧ True := hiddenShared

theorem hiddenA : CleanStatement ∧ True := hiddenOpaque
theorem hiddenB : CleanStatement ∧ True := hiddenOpaque

axiom forbiddenType : Prop
-- The axiom appears in the declared type while the proof body is just cleanOpaque.
theorem typeA : (fun _ : Prop => CleanStatement) forbiddenType := cleanOpaque
theorem typeB : (fun _ : Prop => CleanStatement) forbiddenType := cleanOpaque

files.name: Clean
files.suffix_after_common_declarations:
open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  let allowed := #[``propext, ``Classical.choice, ``Quot.sound]
  let targets := #[``cleanA, ``cleanB]
  let env ← getEnv
  let (_, axiomState) := ((targets.forM Lean.CollectAxioms.collect).run env).run {}
  for n in allowed do
    unless axiomState.axioms.contains n do
      throwError "Fixture failed to exercise allowed axiom {n}"
  unless axiomState.visited.contains ``cleanOpaque && axiomState.visited.contains ``cleanShared do
    throwError "Shared private/opaque clean dependencies were not traversed"
  unless axiomState.axioms.size == 3 do
    throwError "Unused test axioms contaminated clean targets: {axiomState.axioms}"
  logInfo m!"SHARED_UNION_SMOKE: targets={targets}; collected={axiomState.axioms}"
  for axiomName in axiomState.axioms do
    unless allowed.contains axiomName do
      throwError "Audited endpoint union depends on {axiomName}"

end SharedUnionAuditSmoke

open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do

  let targets := #[``hiddenA, ``hiddenB]

    throwError "Hidden private/opaque dependencies were not traversed"

files.name: Type
files.suffix_after_common_declarations:
open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  let allowed := #[``propext, ``Classical.choice, ``Quot.sound]
  let targets := #[``typeA, ``typeB]
  let env ← getEnv
  let (_, axiomState) := ((targets.forM Lean.CollectAxioms.collect).run env).run {}
  for n in allowed do
    unless axiomState.axioms.contains n do
      throwError "Fixture failed to exercise allowed axiom {n}"
  unless axiomState.visited.contains ``cleanOpaque && axiomState.visited.contains ``cleanShared do
    throwError "Shared private/opaque clean dependencies were not traversed"
  for target in targets do
    let ci ← getConstInfo target
    unless ci.type.getUsedConstants.contains ``forbiddenType do
      throwError "Type-only fixture lost the axiom in the declared type"
    let some value := ci.value? true | throwError "Missing fixture proof body"
    if value.getUsedConstants.contains ``forbiddenType then
      throwError "Type-only fixture unexpectedly uses its test axiom directly in its body"
  unless axiomState.axioms.contains ``forbiddenType do
    throwError "Fixture test axiom was not collected"
  unless axiomState.axioms.size == 4 do
    throwError "Unexpected fixture axiom count {axiomState.axioms}"
  logInfo m!"SHARED_UNION_SMOKE: targets={targets}; collected={axiomState.axioms}"
  for axiomName in axiomState.axioms do
    unless allowed.contains axiomName do
      throwError "Audited endpoint union depends on {axiomName}"

end SharedUnionAuditSmoke

files.suffix_after_common_declarations:
open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  let allowed := #[``propext, ``Classical.choice, ``Quot.sound]
  let targets := #[``cleanA, ``cleanB]
  let env ← getEnv
  let (_, axiomState) := ((targets.forM Lean.CollectAxioms.collect).run env).run {}
  for n in allowed do
    unless axiomState.axioms.contains n do
      throwError "Fixture failed to exercise allowed axiom {n}"
  unless axiomState.visited.contains ``cleanOpaque && axiomState.visited.contains ``cleanShared do
    throwError "Shared private/opaque clean dependencies were not traversed"
  unless axiomState.axioms.size == 3 do
    throwError "Unused test axioms contaminated clean targets: {axiomState.axioms}"
  logInfo m!"SHARED_UNION_SMOKE: targets={targets}; collected={axiomState.axioms}"
  let forbidden := axiomState.axioms.filter fun n => !(#[``propext, ``Classical.choice, ``Quot.sound]).contains n
  unless forbidden.isEmpty do
    throwError "Unexpected axiom in endpoint union: {forbidden}"

end SharedUnionAuditSmoke

The production source hashes identify the files read during this review; no claim of a separate frozen release snapshot is made.
